item.text: งานนี้เป็น code review ขนาดเล็ก ผมจะใช้ `matt-review` เพื่อประเมินความถูกต้องกับ requirement และ `ecc-security-review` เพื่อเช็ก authorization/security boundary แล้วอ่านไฟล์คำแนะนำทั้งสองก่อนวิเคราะห์ โดยจะไม่แก้ไฟล์หรือรัน service ใด ๆ

item.aggregated_output:
---
name: matt-review
description: Review a code diff, PR, branch, or substantive implementation for correctness and requirement coverage. Use for code review, missing behavior, regressions, or a final review of a risky change. รีวิว code และตรวจว่าทำครบ requirement. Security-only and complexity-only reviews have separate owners.
metadata:
  owner: matt
---

# Review requirements and implementation

Use the user-specified diff/ref when present and verify it resolves. Otherwise,
inspect working changes for a work-in-progress review, or use verified PR metadata
for a PR. Do not invent a base branch. Request missing scope only when necessary.

Read changed code with relevant callers and tests. Review two lenses:
- Requirement fidelity: missing, incorrect, or unrequested behavior.
- Implementation: actionable correctness, compatibility, and maintainability
  defects supported by code and documented project constraints.

The user request can serve as the spec. Missing tracker setup or a formal spec
is not a reason to stop a useful review. Note material unknowns accurately.

Treat code smells as hypotheses. Show the actual consequence before recommending
extraction, polymorphism, or extra interfaces. Tool-enforced style is not a finding.
Preserve justified seams and apply the engineering policy to simplicity conflicts.

Rank actionable findings by impact. For each, give a precise location, concrete
trigger, consequence, and feasible fix. Distinguish verified defects from untested
risks. If no material findings exist, say so without adding filler warnings.

One focused pass is the default. A second specialist pass is warranted by an
actual independent concern, not every touched file. Delegation requires the host's
authorization. Review-only requests do not authorize fixes, comments, or publishing.


---ECC-SECURITY---

---
name: ecc-security-review
description: Inspect concrete security risks in authentication, authorization, secrets, untrusted input, uploads, shell/SQL execution, or sensitive data changes. Use for security reviews and changes crossing a trust boundary. ตรวจ security และช่องโหว่. Skip ordinary presentation/style changes.
metadata:
  owner: ecc
---

# Review the affected trust boundaries

Trace attacker-controlled input to privileged operations and sensitive output.
Identify the relevant actor, asset, boundary, and enforcement point from real code.

Check applicable concerns only: authentication vs object-level authorization;
validation/canonicalization; SQL or command parameterization; path traversal and
upload limits; output encoding; SSRF destinations/redirects; credential handling;
sensitive logs; session/CSRF protection; error paths and fail-open behavior.

Preserve behavior required for security even when a shorter solution is proposed.
Reuse established security primitives. Do not introduce a validator dependency
or enterprise checklist just because the skill mentions one.

Demonstrate findings with a concrete reachable path and a harmless test where
practical. Redact secrets and avoid dumping credentials or private data.
Distinguish dependency scanner output from verified reachability/exploitability.
Use current primary documentation when framework defaults affect a conclusion.

Report severity, location, exploit preconditions, consequence, and the smallest
effective remediation. If fixing, add a focused negative/authorization regression
check. Never claim a clean scan proves the absence of vulnerabilities.
This is a modifier of the current task, not a separate orchestration workflow.

item.text:
พบ 2 จุดที่ต้องแก้ก่อนใช้:

- **High, ขาด object-level authorization**: `login_required` ยืนยันแค่ว่าล็อกอินแล้ว แต่ไม่ได้ตรวจว่า order เป็นของ `current_user` ผู้ใช้ที่รู้ `order_id` อาจดู order ของคนอื่นได้  
  แก้โดยตรวจ `order.owner_id != current_user.id` แล้วคืน 404 หรือ 403 ตาม convention ของระบบ

- **Medium, ค่า zero ถูกเปลี่ยน**: `order.quantity or 1` เปลี่ยน `0` เป็น `1`  
  ใช้ `1 if order.quantity is None else order.quantity` แทน

ตัวแก้ขั้นต่ำ:

```python
order = get_order(order_id)
if order.owner_id != current_user.id:
    raise NotFound()  # หรือ 403 ตาม contract ของระบบ

quantity = 1 if order.quantity is None else order.quantity
```

ยังต้องแก้ก่อนใช้

ทักษะที่อ่านจริง: `matt-review`, `ecc-security-review`
